bone-collector.notes: Flat 100 (no level scaling). One queued raise_attack of 100 per enemy death event, applied in the next round only (nextRound, not permanent).

battering-ram.notes: Fires when the card in direction front dies (target check) and only if this card damaged it this round (damagedBySelf, extension): a dazed Ram whose target is killed by someone else deals nothing.

bloodsoaked-totem.text: The attack value of each of your offensive cards increases by {v} per round.
bloodsoaked-totem.notes: Permanent +{v} per round (increment_attack) from round 1 to every own card with an attack direction, the Totem included (it attacks its own neighbours). Scope buffs are not split.

bog-yeti.notes: +: round 2, ++: round 3 (reversed relative to the other yetis, per wiki). "2 and 3" = two round_eq buffs (the first matching one fires each round).

baby-dragon.text: Who would kill a baby dragon? It's cute... and if it dies, each of your offensive dragons gains {v} attack power.
baby-dragon.notes: "dragons" = Neutral cards (game-design 1.4). Permanent (increment_attack) buff to every other own Neutral card with an attack direction when Baby Dragon dies.

blood-dragon.text: Summoned from the blood of those who passed, he guards the wisdom of the Fallen.

brother-artujan.text: Heals each of his neighbors by {v} health points per round.

cave-troll.text: Heals himself by {v} health points each round.

catapult.text: Deals no damage from the fourth round on.
catapult.notes: Explicit attack buff replacing the implicit one: attacks only in rounds 1-3 (hasAttack is false from round 4, so a board of Catapults ends the fight).

bone-oracle.text: His neighbors, if orcs, receive no damage in round 2.
bone-oracle.notes: filter.tribe (extension): only orc neighbours become invulnerable.

carnivorous-toadstool.text: It attacks with diffuse spores that cannot be reflected.
carnivorous-toadstool.notes: Explicit attack buff replacing the implicit one; unreflectable (extension): its hits push no onDamage event, so reflect_damage / reflect_damage_to_player never fire. Invulnerable still blocks it.

bone-dragon.text: The first time Bone Dragon dies, it returns to life with improved attack.
bone-dragon.notes: Wiki: revives adding its ability value to its attack (100 + 3100 = 3200 at L1). increment_attack runs before resurrect in the event loop (phase order), once, when it dies. The text has no number, so the value is not displayed.

devourer.text: If Devourer survives a round, it heals {v} for each enemy card that died that round.
devourer.notes: One heal of {v} per enemy death event (original event loop); the heal handler skips a dead target, which is the "if it survives" condition. A heal that lands before the die phase of the event loop can keep it alive (the wiki lists this as a known quirk).

colossus.text: At the end of round two, it kills the opposing card with the highest attack power.
colossus.notes: Extension kill: after the phase list of round 2, the living opposing card with the highest current attack is marked dead (ignores invulnerable; blocked when Colossus is suspended) and an onDeath event is pushed. Ties: the first slot.

crystal-breeder.text: Increases the damage dealt by his neighbors by {v} in the first round.

crystal-golem.text: If the card opposite dies, Crystal Golem does {v} damage to the opposing player.
crystal-golem.notes: onDeath/opponent_cards with directions [front]: fires only when the dying card is the one in front (target check), whoever killed it.

crystal-ghost.text: An aura of experience surrounds him. Mistaken by many for a flamboyant bard.

dark-mage.text: The attack power of all cards with special abilities is reduced by {pct} in round 1.
dark-mage.notes: Value is a percent. Every card with an ability on both sides except itself loses {pct} of its attack in round 1, applied after all raise_attack buffs (wiki) and multiplicatively when several Medusas/Dark Mages are present. The wiki says the card also hits itself; game-design.md 1.4 (except itself) wins, as before.

cursed-stag.text: The opposite card does not inflict damage for 2 rounds.

dwarven-sage.notes: raise_player_hp is re-applied every round in the original (player hp resets at round start), i.e. the bonus lasts while the Sage lives and is not suspended. The wiki says the bonus persists after his death once applied; the original model is kept.

dwarf-judge.text: At the end of round two, she kills the opposing card with the lowest attack power.

djinn.text: The healing power of each of your cards increases by {pct}.
djinn.notes: Value is a percent. While Djinn lives (and is not suspended) every heal buff of an own card heals round(strength x (1 + pct/100)); several Djinns add their percents on the base heal. Not applied to heal_player or raise_player_hp.

flameling.notes: Its normal attack goes to frontLeft/frontRight; the death attack hits the front slot with 100% of its base attack (empty slot: the opposing player).

enormous-larva.text: The first time Enormous Larva dies, it returns to life with improved attack.
enormous-larva.notes: Wiki: returns with its base attack x 11 (the catalog ability column is exactly 11 x attack at every level). Encoded as a permanent +1000% of base attack (origAttack x 10 added) fired by its own death, before the resurrect in the same event loop.

giant-spider.text: If Giant Spider survives a round, it heals {v} for each enemy card that died that round.
giant-spider.notes: One heal of {v} per enemy death event (original event loop); the heal handler skips a dead target, which is the "if it survives" condition. A heal that lands before the die phase of the event loop can keep it alive (the wiki lists this as a known quirk).

goblin-patriarch.text: The cards opposite his neighbors do no damage in round 1. If killed, Goblin Patriarch attacks both neighbors for double damage.
goblin-patriarch.notes: Death attack: 200% of base attack split over two directions = 1x base attack to each own neighbour (wiki). Off-board directions are skipped; an empty neighbour slot sends the share to the opponent player in the original attack handler (the wiki says the own player).

gargoyle.text: The first time it dies, it returns to life at full health.

goblin-cook.text: Increases your health by {v}, but poisons you in round 4.
goblin-cook.notes: Poison amount is not documented; assumed equal to the health bonus (taken back as damage in round 4), as decided earlier.

goblin-mob.text: Does triple damage in the first round.
goblin-mob.notes: Wiki: +2x the basic (unbuffed) attack in round 1, additive, not a multiplier of the buffed attack: strengthPercent 200 of origAttack (baseAttack).
